title: Taiwanese American Student Association at Emory University
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association at Emory University (Emory TASA) is a student organization founded in 2003 on Emory’s Atlanta campus. According to its About page, the organization’s goal has been to promote awareness of the culture and heritage of Taiwan and Taiwanese Americans through social and cultural events aimed at the entire Emory community. The organization welcomes all interested students, not only those of Taiwanese descent.

Emory TASA has a documented history of collaborative programming with neighboring institutions, including joint events with Georgia Tech’s TASA chapter. It has also participated in the Intercollegiate Taiwanese American Student Association (iTASA) conference network. The organization maintains a Facebook page (@EmoryUTASA) and an Instagram account (@emorytasa) in addition to its WordPress site. Its WordPress blog shows last activity in 2012, and its Facebook page engagement appears low, raising uncertainty about current activity levels. The Instagram account exists but its activity level could not be independently confirmed from available sources.
